onset.Description: Onset of the event relative to the first scanner trigger pulse.

duration.Description: Duration of the event. Fixed maximum response window (1.5s).

trial_type.Description: Type of trial within the Stop-Signal Task.

Levels.go: Go trial in which the participant is instructed to respond to the arrow.
Levels.stop: Stop trial in which the participant is instructed to withhold the response.

arrow_direction.Description: Direction of the arrow presented on the trial.

Levels.correct_go: Correct response on a go trial.
Levels.incorrect_go: Incorrect response on a go trial. Responded but with the wrong key.
Levels.missed_go: No response at all on a go trial.
Levels.failed_stop: Response made on a stop trial, indicating failed inhibition.
Levels.successful_stop: No response made on a stop trial, indicating successful inhibition.

response_time.Description: Response time (first press). n/a if no response was made.

key_pressed.Description: Response key pressed by the participant for the first response. n/a if no response was made.

Levels.other_or_invalid: A key was pressed that did not match any of the expected response keys.

response_time_2.Description: Response time (second press), when present. n/a if no second press occurred.

key_pressed_2.Description: Response key pressed by the participant for the second response, when present. n/a if no second press was made.

Levels.other_or_invalid: A key was pressed that did not match any of the expected response keys.

requested_soa.Description: Requested stop-signal onset asynchrony between the go stimulus and the stop signal.

true_soa.Description: Actual stop-signal onset asynchrony between the go stimulus and the stop signal.
